title: EdgeHome MIoT Bridge Execute Request
description: Request body posted by EdgeHome Harness to a private MIoT/Xiaomi bridge after Rust validation, registry resolution, policy gating, and dry-run planning.

route_id.description: Opaque route owned by the private bridge. It maps to did/siid/piid/aiid/token outside the public harness.

device_id.description: Public harness device_id from the trusted device registry.

arguments.description: Normalized, backend-neutral arguments. The bridge maps them to device-specific MIoT properties or actions.
